name: Value-array flood: a single Condition key carrying > MAX_CONDITION_VALUES values
note: A-condition-budget regression (defense-in-depth). classifyConditions does O(values) work per condition key (toValueArray + valueNarrowsKey inspect every value); a single key carrying a huge value array is a DoS work concern. validate.js caps Action/Resource counts but NOT Condition value arrays, and the classifier used to charge the cooperative work budget only ONE unit per KEY regardless of how many values it hid. This statement carries 50001 values on aws:SourceVpc (> LIMITS.MAX_CONDITION_VALUES = 50000). The shared engine (engine/masked-grant.js) routes the over-cap statement to coverage.summary.incomplete via TOO_MANY_CONDITION_VALUES rather than silently analyzing (or dropping) the flood, so NEITHER the browser (analyze) NOR the CLI (scan) reports a clean pass. Values are never dropped and the whole document is never discarded (validate stays ok:true). No verdict-semantics change for any policy under the generous cap.
